blocks.title: Recognizing phishing
blocks.text: Phishing pehchanne ka matlab un jaali paighamat ko pehchanna hai jo password, card number ya bank tafseel nikalwana chahte hain, aur un ke links na dabana ya maloomat na dena.
Bank ki lagne wali email jo link daba kar account tafseel maange use jaali samjhein; is ki bajaye bank se us ke official number ya app se rabta karein.

blocks.prompt: Online khatre pehchanne aur cyber khatron se bachne ke do tareeqe bataiye (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Tafseel maangne wala har ghair mutawaqqo paigham jaanchein: bhejne wale ki tasdeeq karein aur links na dabayein, balke idare se seedha rabta karein. Antivirus update rakhein aur software sirf bharosemand maakhaz se download karein, ta ke malware nuqsan se pehle pakra jaye.

items: Phishing pehchanein: tafseel ki mashkook darkhwastein; official zariye se tasdeeq.
